name: God-Eternals
description: Four immense Eternals, once Amonkhet's gods, killed by Bolas and now his servants, who tear apart Vitu-Ghazi.

description_citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
description_citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Four God-Eternals emerge from the portal over Tenth District Plaza, and Samut identifies them as her plane's gods, now Bolas's servants.

timeline.summary: The God-Eternals tear apart Vitu-Ghazi, and Domri cheers and announces the Gruul will join the dragon.

timeline.summary: Kaya recalls Vitu-Ghazi's dormancy after the God-Eternals' damage and sets out with Kellan.
timeline.quote: When last Kaya had seen Vitu-Ghazi, the great living guildhall had been dormant
